# DJZS: deterministic pre-execution audit for agents

> DJZS audits the reasoning behind an autonomous agent's move before capital is committed and
> returns a tri-state verdict (PASS, WAIT, or FAIL) with the reasoning defects flagged and a
> reproducible verdict_hash. It answers "should this position be taken?", complementary to
> transaction-security tools that answer "is this transaction safe to sign?".

## Get a verdict now: one POST, free, no wallet

- POST https://mcp.djzs.ai/try/verdict with content-type: application/json and the body
  { "kind": "pm", "anon": "<32 lowercase hex characters your agent keeps>", "intent": { "thesis": "<the idea in plain words>" } }
- kind "pm": a prediction-market bet. Name the venue (Kalshi, Polymarket, Limitless), the market question,
  your side and price, where your odds come from and when you read it, and what would prove you wrong.
  kind "perp": a perp or spot trade. Instrument, long or short, entry, stop, size, leverage, and the reason
  the price should move.
- Returns verdict (PASS, WAIT or FAIL; REFUSED_SCOPE when the idea is not the kind named), risk_score,
  flags_detail (each fired rule with a plain name and severity), unknown_fields (what the check could not
  settle), verdict_hash, intent_sha256, ruleset and quota. WAIT means treat it as a no until the unknown
  fields are fixed. A WAIT also carries unsettled: per unknown field, whether the three readings disagreed,
  all flagged it but quoted different text, or found nothing, and the sentences of your text they pointed
  at, verbatim. Free verdicts are not attested and not anchored.
- 3 per anon id per UTC day, or 5 per wallet when the caller signs (see "Free verdicts" below); a global
  daily cap also applies. Checks left: GET https://mcp.djzs.ai/try/quota?anon=<id>. Intent up to 4096 bytes.
- The same check in a browser: https://djzs.ai/ (paste the idea into the box).

## Use it (live MCP gate)

- Endpoint (streamable HTTP): https://mcp.djzs.ai/mcp
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport http djzs-trust https://mcp.djzs.ai/mcp`
- Lead tool: `verify_pm_trade`: pass a free-text prediction-market thesis; returns
  PASS→PROCEED / FAIL / WAIT→HALT, flags, unknown_fields, disagreements, and verdict_hash.
  Optional `agent_address` (0x wallet) links the verdict to that agent's on-chain trust record.
  Prediction-market only: a non-PM or undetermined intent returns in_scope:false (never a silent
  perpetuals audit).
- Second paid tool: `verify_perp_trade`: pass a free-text perpetual or spot TRADE thesis (direction,
  size, leverage, entry, stop, target, venue, and the REASON). Same verdict shape, same price. A position
  stated with no thesis FAILS (DJZS-S01); an unbounded position FAILS (DJZS-X01); an unresolvable stop or
  thesis WAITs. Prediction-market bets are refused here (in_scope:false, not charged); use verify_pm_trade.
  The two tools run separate extraction contracts (X-v1.1 for PM, X-LF-v1.2 for trades); see https://djzs.ai/docs/concepts/extraction.
  Hyperliquid perps: name the venue in the intent. The audit covers the stated reasoning (thesis, stop,
  leverage, data sources); it does not read the venue's live price, funding or liquidation data.
- Free check over MCP: `check_thesis` (kind: prediction_market or perp_or_spot; thesis: the user's own words). Same
  engine and rulesets as the paid audits, same PASS / WAIT / FAIL and reasons. No wallet, no payment, no receipt:
  nothing is attested or anchored. One shared daily allowance for all MCP callers; LIMIT_REACHED when used up.
- Other tools (free): `query_pol_certificates` (reads ProofOfLogic certificates from Irys mainnet,
  including every certificate verify_pm_trade anchors);
  `query_agent_trust` (on-chain audit record read from the DJZS subgraph: total_audits, scored_audits
  (PASS plus FAIL; WAIT is excluded and reported as wait_count), pass/fail counts, fail_rate and its
  Wilson 95% lower bound, latest verdict/risk, DJZS-S01/X01 flag counts. Below 10 scored audits it
  returns INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY and no rate. It returns evidence, not a decision: no threshold, no HALT).
- Paying: verify_pm_trade and verify_perp_trade each cost 2.00 USDC per audit on Base mainnet over x402. MCP-native payer:
  wrap your MCP client with withX402Client (agents/x402) using an account holding USDC on Base,
  network "base", and maxPaymentValue 2000000n; the library's default cap is 0.10 USDC and
  refuses this price. Gas is facilitator-paid. Full recipe: https://djzs.ai/docs/agents/mcp
- MPP (Machine Payments Protocol), live 2026-11-01: verify_pm_trade and verify_perp_trade also accept an MPP
  credential. The 402 carries WWW-Authenticate: Payment (method evm, intent charge, USDC on Base 8453,
  2000000 atomic) beside PAYMENT-REQUIRED. No-code client: npx mppx https://mcp.djzs.ai/x402/verify_perp_trade
  --protocol mpp -J '{"intent":{...}}' from a wallet holding USDC on Base. Same facilitator, same treasury,
  same verdict and receipt; the 200 adds a Payment-Receipt header. /x402/verify (legacy alias) is x402-only.
  The offer is listed in https://mcp.djzs.ai/openapi.json (x-payment-info.offers).
- Free verdicts (2026-09-28): POST https://mcp.djzs.ai/try/verdict runs the same engine without
  payment or attestation, 5 per wallet per UTC day. The caller signs an EIP-191 text naming its
  address, the UTC day and the intent's sha256 (fetch the exact text from GET https://mcp.djzs.ai/try/quota).
  Body: { kind: "pm" | "perp", intent, address, day, signature }. The response carries the paid
  route's offer; the 2.00 USDC buys the attested receipt on any outcome. Browser: https://djzs.ai/

## How it works

- Architecture C: an LLM extracts observable facts (N=3 consensus, quote gates, evidence-unanimity)
  and never returns a verdict; a frozen deterministic engine computes the verdict. The verdict rules
  are model-independent. Same input struct -> same verdict_hash.
- WAIT is never silent: an unknown decision-critical fact drains to HALT with unknown_fields returned.

## Receipts (v2, reproducible by anyone)

- Every paid verdict returns intent_hash (EIP-712 typed data, domain DJZS / 2 / eip155:8453) and
  writes an EAS attestation on Base under schema
  0x5ef67e2b8c617635431401d2872b2a6f79eeba54a8e19fd5ecd45aceda2a2030 from attester
  0xfB0e11471D41f88D1eE43A1bA38d885fb6b77824 onto the paying agent's address. intent_sha256 (v1)
  is returned alongside: sha256 over renderIntentText(intent): sorted keys, one `key: value` line each.
- Recompute any receipt with zero trust in DJZS: https://djzs.ai/verify
- Scoring rules, verdict formula, both binding contracts: https://djzs.ai/docs/concepts/rulesets
- Disclosures and corrections: https://djzs.ai/docs/disclosures
- For agent-framework builders and treasuries (Safe Guard / AgentKit posture): https://djzs.ai/builders

## Taxonomies (frozen)

- DJZS-M (prediction market, DJZS-PM-v1.0): M01-M04, weights sum 100, FAIL threshold 25. All live.
- DJZS-LF (perpetuals, DJZS-LF-v1.2): 11 codes, weights sum 200, 4 wired live (E01, I01, X01, S01).

## Live posture (stated honestly)

- verify_pm_trade and verify_perp_trade are PAID: 2.00 USDC per audit over x402 or MPP (one CDP facilitator) on Base mainnet,
  non-custodial (payer -> treasury via EIP-3009; the facilitator submits the transfer and pays gas).
  The registry tools (query_pol_certificates, query_agent_trust) are free.
- Certificates anchor to Irys MAINNET and are permanent; retrievable by id and via
  query_pol_certificates.
- The trust loop is CLOSED and live: pass agent_address to verify_pm_trade and the verdict is
  written on-chain (DJZSLogicTrustScore on Base) by a dedicated authorized writer, indexed by the
  DJZS subgraph on The Graph, and readable by anyone via query_agent_trust. The write is fail-open:
  a write fault never blocks or alters the audit or its certificate.
- Endpoint history: the gate previously served at djzs-trust-mcp.easy-less-spoil.workers.dev/mcp.
  That URL still works for existing clients; https://mcp.djzs.ai/mcp is canonical.

## Scan Room (the gate's proof layer, public)

- https://scan.djzs.ai/ : the Scan Room: narratives from the Daily Narrative Scan
  (the story as it circulates, a 0-100 score, PASS/WAIT/FAIL, the one condition that would prove it wrong)
  and members' calls, graded in public on a hash-chained ledger. Misses publish too. https://djzs.ai/scan redirects there.
- Ways in (post a call on the page; reply /claim on X or comment it on YouTube;
  agents use the JSON API with a key minted on the page once Sign in with X is on). What each door does today,
  automatic or by hand, is in feed.json under "doors". Machine read: https://scan.djzs.ai/feed.json · https://scan.djzs.ai/ledger.jsonl ·
  https://scan.djzs.ai/llms.txt · method and chain verification: https://scan.djzs.ai/method
- Verdicts there are evidence states, not instructions: the verdict is on the narrative, never the contract.

## Source of truth

- Repository: https://github.com/SIFR0-dev/djzs-AI
- Reference integration (Polymarket CLOB): https://github.com/SIFR0-dev/djzs-polymarket-gate
  Audits the thesis, places the order only on a clean in-scope PASS. Uses withX402Client from
  agents/x402 (the client this gate speaks; other x402 clients complete the handshake but do
  not settle here). Out-of-scope refusal verified free on-chain; paid path not yet exercised.
- Every number here traces to that tree; where docs and tree disagree, the tree wins.
